subject: Panacea privacy inventory request - international transfers & DPF evidence
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@panaceahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Panacea Legal <legal@panaceahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Panacea privacy inventory request - international transfers & DPF evidence

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking this — Panacea is running procurement diligence for a cross-border deployment and we need a short inventory and evidentiary pack from Redwood to close our legal review. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following by 2028-06-15? Our priority is to validate technical and legal safeguards for transfers out of the EU.

Items requested (high level):
- Completed DPA annex (we will provide a template) and any deviations you anticipate
- Data protection framework mapping (DPF) showing cross-border flows and lawful bases
- List of subprocessors by jurisdiction and whether data stays in-region or routes to US
- KMS/HSM design and key rotation policy (high level description acceptable)
- SOC 2 / ISO attestation and date of last audit; any outstanding findings
- Retention/erasure controls and data deletion playbook for controller requests

Attached is our RFI template for context (Panacea_RFI_v1.docx). If timelines are tight, tell us a prioritized subset and we can narrow scope.

Also please confirm a point of contact for technical evidence.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Privacy Operations
Panacea Health

Attachment: Panacea_RFI_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@panaceahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 11:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Panacea privacy inventory request - international transfers & DPF evidence

Elena — thanks for the clear list and the template.

Quick answers up front: yes, we can provide the inventory and evidence. Monica (cc'd) will lead the technical pack; I will coordinate the DPA annex and commercial items. Proposed delivery: 10 business days for the prioritized pack you listed, with full deliverables by 2028-06-15 as requested. If you need anything sooner we can prioritize the DPF mapping and subprocessor roster.

To make sure we align: can you confirm whether Panacea needs a redlined DPA or a completed annex draft + markup? Also let us know if there are any region-specific controls (e.g., EU-only residency requirement) that should be emphasized — that will change the subprocessor detail we send.

I've attached a short executive summary of our DPF and transfer safeguards to accelerate review: redwood_dpf_summary.pdf.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Director, Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: redwood_dpf_summary.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@panaceahealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Jun 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Panacea privacy inventory request - international transfers & DPF evidence

Hi Elena — Monica on the security team here. Thanks for the RFI; below are clarifications and the items we can deliver quickly.

What we will include in the prioritized pack (targeted delivery within 5 business days):
- DPF mapping PDF (flows from EU controllers -> Redwood endpoints, with routing flags and caching notes)
- Subprocessor inventory CSV (by region) and last-known contract status
- KMS/HSM overview: we use a cloud KMS with customer-key support; keys are hardware-backed (HSM), rotated on a 90-day cadence by default; detailed separation of duties and audit logging included in the pack
- SOC 2 Type II report summary and the date of last audit (we'll include cover page and binder reference)
- Retention & deletion playbook excerpt with API endpoints and runbook steps for controller deletion requests

Items requiring a bit more time (will follow in the full deliverable):
- Fully completed DPA annex (we can generate a completed annex draft and note any deviations from your template)
- Detailed per-model/route KV-cache residency map (depends on model routing policy)

Attachments included: subprocessor_inventory_by_region.csv, dpa-annex-template.docx (we will populate and return a draft). I also recorded a short walkthrough explaining the DPF map and our routing fallbacks: https://redwood.cloud/recordings/dpf-walkthrough-20280602

A few quick Qs to ensure the CSV is useful: do you want vendors grouped by controller data-categories (PII, health, aggregated telemetry) or by legal jurisdiction only?

I will send the prioritized pack to the secure SharePoint link or via our SFTP depending on your preference; let me know which is preferable.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Panacea privacy inventory request - international transfers & DPF evidence

Thanks Marcus & Monica — that plan works. Panacea prefers: first delivery via secure SharePoint (we will create a folder and invite "redwood-diligence@panaceahealth.com") and a completed DPA annex draft (we will accept a draft + redline).

A couple of follow-ups we need as part of the prioritized pack:
- KMS key rotation schedule and whether customer-managed keys are supported for dedicated/private deployments
- Confirmation in the DPF that EU-origin requests do not persist in US-only caches (or list exceptions)
- The subprocessor CSV grouped by jurisdiction and indicated whether subprocessor access is limited to metadata vs. content

Panacea Legal asked that any SOC 2 binders or attestation pages be delivered with a checksum and that the DPA annex draft be sent via DocuSign once ready.

If you can get the prioritized pack in the secure folder by EOD 06/09 that would help our internal reviewers. We may request a short call with Monica next week to walk through the DPF.

Best regards,
Elena Soto
Head of Privacy Operations
Panacea Health
